storyline.real: Mercedes undercut Verstappen with an early stop for Hamilton; Verstappen catches him late, passes him off the track at Turn 4, is told to give the place back and finishes second, 0.745 seconds behind.
storyline.headline: No track limits needed: Verstappen wins the season opener in Bahrain

mastery.label: Win on no more than two stops

eras.briefing: Bahrain, 2021. The season opener: Verstappen starts from pole, Hamilton alongside him in second.
